title: Retail finance end-to-end platform
subtitle: End-to-end B2B/B2C SaaS architecture and scalable design system for regulated financial and retail workflows.
cardOutcomeSummary: -20% dev time via design system & 3-min faster shop workflows.

executiveSummary.roleAndScope: Product Designer at Multiapoyo (June 2022 - July 2024). Within a 4-person design squad, I led end-to-end UX/UI architecture, on-site shop field testing, engineering handoff across three SaaS platforms (Admin, Ops, Customer), and co-authored the GoldenWeb Design System (V1 & V2).
executiveSummary.coreDecision: I built a variant-driven, atomic design system (GoldenWeb DS) before scaling feature screens and collapsed multi-screen legacy audits into linear confirmation flows, allowing engineering to absorb a mid-project corporate rebrand without stalling MVP delivery.
executiveSummary.verifiedOutcome: -20% MVP development cycle time (verified by frontend engineering leadership) and 3 to 4 minute faster product registration and sales (-30% clicks) validated via live shop field testing.

sections.heading: The constraint and problem
sections.overviewTitle: Regulated multi-role operations under low-tech constraints
sections.overviewBody: Multiapoyo needed to modernize legacy lending and retail software into a multi-tenant B2B/B2C SaaS serving branch staff, store administrators, and retail borrowers. Store employees worked on low-resolution 1280x832 terminals, distrusted opaque digital states during cash and collateral transactions, and required zero-training clarity.

items.title: High-risk financial accuracy
items.description: Missing confirmation feedback forced staff to double-check completed loans, audits, and cash movements manually.

items.title: Engineering handoff bottlenecks
items.description: Three interconnected platforms (Admin, Ops, Customer) risked UI drift and slow frontend velocity without shared tokens.

items.title: Mid-project brand pivot
items.description: Leadership introduced an external rebrand post-MVP, requiring rapid visual overhaul without breaking active production logic.

sections.heading: Key decisions and tradeoffs: 3-platform SaaS architecture
sections.description: I separated administrative configuration from high-velocity floor operations while unifying all three surfaces under shared interaction patterns.

cards.title: Admin platform (B2B tenant control)
cards.description: Multi-branch setup, role permissions, and catalog import workflows separated cleanly from daily counter traffic.

cards.title: Ops platform (point-of-sale and collateral audits)
cards.description: Streamlined counter terminal UI enabling staff to buy, sell, appraise, and audit inventory with 30% fewer clicks.

cards.title: Customer platform (B2C online store and payments)
cards.description: Mobile-first portal letting borrowers track loan status, renew terms, and browse merchandise without visiting a branch.

sections.heading: Design system: GoldenWeb DS V2
sections.description: Tradeoff: Investing upfront in tokenized Figma component architecture slowed initial wireframing by one sprint, but accelerated overall MVP frontend development by 20% and let us execute a complete post-MVP corporate rebrand seamlessly.

typography.description: Field testing on V1 revealed small body text strained branch operators on 1280x832 monitors; in V2 we scaled base legibility up and paired Tragic Grotesk headings with Work Sans UI copy.

colors.description: Migrated from legacy green V1 tokens to vibrant V2 brand tokens tuned explicitly for accessible contrast across financial states.

gridsCard.title: Terminal and mobile grids (1280x832 and 360x800)
gridsCard.description: Calibrated breakpoints for low-resolution store desktops and large Android retail handsets.

iconographyCard.title: Standardized Material iconography
iconographyCard.description: Adopted Material Symbols for rapid dev parity and instant visual recognition across counter operations.

atomicNote.title: Atomic construction and engineering handoff
atomicNote.description: Documented component variants and semantic states directly alongside React engineering leads.

categories.title: Atoms and tokens
categories.description: Semantic color tokens (#5A5AFF, #2A2C2F, #FFFFFF), accessible contrast scales, and typography presets.

categories.title: Molecules and organisms
categories.description: Validated financial input groups, filter selects, inline error tooltips, and directional action controls.

leftCard.title: Competitive benchmarking
leftCard.description: Benchmarked industry incumbents and commerce workflows to eliminate training overhead:

rightCards.title: On-site shop field observation
rightCards.description: Observed branch clerks executing live transactions to compare time-on-task and error recovery against legacy software.

rightCards.title: Behavioral and audit data
rightCards.description: Analyzed Multiapoyo support logs and double-entry mistakes to prioritize high-frequency sales and audit flows.

sections.heading: Operational workflows and engineering handoff
sections.description: Due to confidentiality, I can share scoped views of the critical inventory audit, onboarding, and return flows.

flows.title: Core counter and compliance workflows
flows.description: Replaced nested legacy modals with sequential, reversible audit and product-return flows engineered for zero training.
whatIDid: I consolidated redundant verification screens into contextual confirmation banners and structured modal templates.
I delivered documented component specs, keyboard tab order, and interaction prototypes directly to frontend engineering.
impact: Cut item registration and sale completion time by 3 to 4 minutes (-30% clicks).
Reduced frontend MVP development cycle time by 20% via GoldenWeb Design System reuse.

sections.heading: Failure modes and edge cases
sections.description: Field testing exposed two critical edge cases: operators doubted whether cash transactions succeeded without persistent status banners, and V1 typography proved too small on low-DPI branch displays.

beforeAfter.title: Before vs. after field validation
beforeAfter.description: Eliminated duplicate verification dialogs in favor of persistent alert banners and elevated typography.

sections.heading: Verified outcomes and what I'd do differently

items.title: -20% dev cycle time
items.description: Frontend engineering leadership confirmed the GoldenWeb Design System accelerated MVP build velocity by ~20% while surviving a full post-MVP rebrand.

items.title: 3 to 4 min faster flows (-30% clicks)
items.description: Usability and on-site shop field testing cut item registration and checkout time by 3 to 4 minutes and virtually eliminated employee training.

items.title: Live counter field testing
items.description: Shadowed branch clerks processing live collateral and sales transactions to benchmark speed and error recovery against legacy software.

items.title: A/B screen and banner testing
items.description: Validated removal of redundant confirmation screens by replacing them with unmistakable inline banners and alerts.

items.title: Senior retrospective
items.description: I would enforce strict WCAG contrast guardrails before accepting marketing's bright V2 brand palette and standardize Figma component documentation across all four designers from week one. I would also decouple Multiapoyo-specific sub-flows earlier via card sorting so external SaaS tenants received cleaner defaults out of the box.
